source.name: DraftKings Network published betting splits
source.extract_scope: Listed player/line/period only. Article handle and number-of-bet percentages deliberately not treated as win probabilities.

unavailable_or_not_yet_ingested.note: Published ranking exists for Allen, Williams, Nacua, Cook, Adams, Kincaid, Shakir, Coleman, Corum, Higbee, Knox; no comparable odds snapshot in this source

grading_principles: No retroactive prop predictions from these captured markets.
First-half/quarter stats require official play-by-play or period breakdowns, not full-game box score.
Inactive/DNP props require book-specific settlement terms; never mark automatic under.
Line snapshots from different publications are separate quotes, not proof of line movement.
Multiple related markets from one player/game are statistically correlated, not independent successes.
